{name} is a real database: it was created from the Bilgin template, its rows live in that database.

There is nothing to produce or to build here: the golden answers are the golden SQL that runs in that database
with the read-only login.

cli.help.build_db: builds the synthetic database and the T-SQL script
cli.help.build_index: builds the search index from the schema and rules
cli.help.eval_retrieval: measures retrieval recall on the golden questions
cli.help.import_map: maps an Excel schema map; --accept writes the schema
cli.help.introspect: introspects the database and writes the skeleton schema
cli.help.diff_map: compares the Excel map with the database, writes the diff to diff.json/md
cli.help.merge_map: merges the Excel map with the database, writes the schema to --out
cli.help.make_login_script: produces and writes the read-only MSSQL login script
cli.help.ask: runs a single question through the model and shows the answer
cli.help.serve: runs the web API and the UI bound to your own machine
cli.help.user: lists, adds and changes user accounts
cli.help.user_add: adds a new user, asks for the password twice
cli.help.user_list: lists users, their roles and last logins
cli.help.user_set: changes the role, the status or the business role
cli.help.eval: runs the golden questions and writes the report
cli.help.embed_model: model name of the openai source, e.g. bge-m3 (default: BILGIN_EMBED_MODEL)
cli.help.summaries: include table summaries in search: on, off (default off)
cli.help.map_file: path to the Excel schema map
cli.help.accept: applies the mapping to every row and writes the schema (code builds the app, not the model)
cli.help.mapping: mapping file for --accept (default: the one just written)
cli.help.sample: adds up to {n} sample values to short text columns
cli.help.db_live: other side: introspects the live database
cli.help.db_schema: other side: a ready skeleton file
cli.help.db_live_merge: side to merge: introspects the live database
cli.help.db_schema_merge: side to merge: a ready skeleton file
cli.help.question: the question, e.g. "What was last month's revenue?"
cli.help.json: print only the answer's JSON (the same single door as the web API)
cli.help.choice: clarification choice: runs the question with the chosen meaning, does not ask again
cli.help.conversation: ask the question as a continuation of this conversation (earlier turns enter the context)
cli.help.new: open a new conversation and name it on the last line
cli.help.tag: only questions carrying one of these tags (space separated)
cli.help.eval_mode: context mode (default %(default)s); auto is only for ask
cli.help.compare: runs the three modes on the same questions and compares them in one report
cli.help.fresh: with --compare, also runs the modes that would not be rerun
cli.help.models: model x mode comparison with --compare: comma-separated profile names
cli.help.repeat: with --compare, runs each mode N times and measures the noise (default %(default)s)
cli.help.schema: schema of the run: full name or path (default %(default)s)
cli.help.ambiguous: adds the dataset's ambiguous set to the golden questions and measures the clarification metrics
cli.help.narrate: narrates every submitted golden answer and counts the narrator's source
cli.help.followups: runs the dataset's follow-up question chains through the conversation after the golden run and measures the context
cli.help.template: writes the blank fill-in template; --dataset fills the skeleton from that dataset's schema
cli.help.paths: prints every path the install reads, by name; never a secret or a connection string
cli.help.secret_set: writes a model key to the secrets folder with DPAPI; asks for the key twice
cli.help.secret_set_env: name of the environment variable the key is read from, e.g. OPENAI_API_KEY
cli.help.service_check: checks the model endpoint and the dataset's database connection; warnings only, exit code always 0
cli.help.service_check_model: model profile to check; BILGIN_LLM_MODEL when omitted
cli.help.service_xml: writes the WinSW XML of the Windows service; no secret goes into it
cli.help.service_xml_model: the service's model profile; BILGIN_LLM_MODEL when omitted
cli.help.service_xml_out: file the XML is written to; printed to stdout when omitted
